rule_description: Primary KPI must be equal or better
required_condition: scenario_primary_kpi_value >= baseline_primary_kpi_value OR direction is improvement

rule_description: No supporting KPI may be worse
required_condition: all quantified supporting KPIs show no adverse change OR are not quantified

rule_description: Confidence must be equal or higher
Contradiction severity must be equal or lower
Displacement risk must be equal or lower
Governance burden must be equal or lower
Assumption intensity must be equal or lower
